enrollment.method: SDK CLI start_login / finish_login with private in-game verification code
enrollment.code_delivery_evidence: The participating player supplied the requested code and reported seeing it in Minecraft chat.
enrollment.exchange_evidence: The retained login command completed with exit code 0; saved player access was subsequently accepted by the authenticated account endpoint.

limitations: One successful live enrollment; not an exhaustive enrollment failure/security test.
Original private message display is player-reported; no screenshot or delivery telemetry is retained here.
Approximate enrollment timing comes from retained command/result timestamps, not server-side enrollment audit timestamps.
This predates the current candidate onboarding helper and does not validate every candidate helper step.
No new login, code delivery, credential issuance, control acquisition, resume or gameplay occurred during this evidence check.
